name: prioritization
description: Priority scoring of engagement observations against the stated objective.

impact.instructions: How much would successfully exploiting or resolving this observation advance the stated objective?
criteria: Dead end: unrelated to the objective
Marginal: minor supporting information at best
Useful: real progress or a meaningful stepping stone
Strong: direct path to the objective or equivalent value

quick_win.instructions: This observation can be checked or exploited quickly with low effort and standard tooling.
